description: DDL/DML option breadth from the Snowflake-corpus audit: CLONE with time travel (engine parses AT/BEFORE and clones current state - live really time-travels, so those steps skip snowflake), TAG clauses everywhere (tags must exist), ROW ACCESS POLICY attached at CREATE (DDL acceptance; the attach-metadata asserts read the in-memory catalog and stay dropped), UNDROP TAG, SAMPLE method/seed variants incl. a session-variable size, CREATE STAGE property forms, COPY INTO parenthesized option groups getting past the parser (pinned to their non-syntax runtime refusals), DESCRIBE ... TYPE=STAGE, ALTER TABLE SET property forms, per-column IF NOT EXISTS, head/tail table and view properties, sequences with WITH/commas/inline comments, and dynamic-table column lists on either side of the options. Converted from ddl/DdlOptionBreadthTest (now retired).

skip.reason: Frostlake parses AT/BEFORE and clones current state; a real account really time-travels and fails for offsets before the table's creation (Java test had the same assumption)

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE tt_at CLONE tt_src AT (OFFSET => -3600)
CREATE TABLE tt_before CLONE tt_src BEFORE (STATEMENT => '8e5d0ca9-005e-44e6-b858-a8f5b37c5726')
CREATE SCHEMA tt_schema_clone CLONE test_schema AT (TIMESTAMP => CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
CREATE DATABASE tt_db_clone CLONE test_db AT (OFFSET => -60)
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS key1
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS key2
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS k
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS a
CREATE TABLE tagged (id INTEGER) TAG (key1='value_1', key2='value_2')
ALTER TABLE tagged ADD col1 VARCHAR NOT NULL TAG (key1='value_1'), col2 VARCHAR TAG (key2='v2')
CREATE TABLE col_tagged (id INTEGER TAG (k='v'), name VARCHAR)

CREATE OR REPLACE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_tagged COPY GRANTS (a, b) COMMENT='foo' TAG (a='b')
AS SELECT id AS a, name AS b FROM col_tagged
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_grants (uid) COPY GRANTS AS (SELECT 1)
CREATE ROW ACCESS POLICY eu_only AS (r VARCHAR) RETURNS BOOLEAN -> r = 'EU'
CREATE TABLE regions (r VARCHAR) ROW ACCESS POLICY eu_only ON (r)
CREATE VIEW eu_view WITH ROW ACCESS POLICY eu_only ON (r) AS SELECT r FROM regions
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_t SAMPLE BLOCK (100) SEED (42)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_t SAMPLE BLOCK (100) REPEATABLE (99992)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_t SAMPLE BERNOULLI ($s) SEED (0)
CREATE STAGE st_creds URL='s3://bucket-123' FILE_FORMAT=(TYPE='JSON') CREDENTIALS=(aws_key_id='test' aws_secret_key='test')
COPY INTO load1 FROM @%load1/data1/ CREDENTIALS = (AWS_KEY_ID='id' AWS_SECRET_KEY='key' AWS_TOKEN='token') FILES = ('test1.csv', 'test2.csv') FORCE = TRUE
COPY INTO load1 (c1) FROM 's3://mybucket/data/files' STORAGE_INTEGRATION = "storage" ENCRYPTION = (TYPE='NONE' MASTER_KEY='key') FILES = ('file1.csv') CREDENTIALS = ()
ALTER TABLE d_t SET STAGE_COPY_OPTIONS = (ON_ERROR=SKIP_FILE SIZE_LIMIT=5 PURGE=TRUE MATCH_BY_COLUMN_NAME=CASE_SENSITIVE)
ALTER TABLE d_t SET STAGE_FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE=CSV FIELD_DELIMITER='|' NULL_IF=('') FIELD_OPTIONALLY_ENCLOSED_BY='"' TIMESTAMP_FORMAT='TZHTZM YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.FF9')
ALTER TABLE d_t ADD IF NOT EXISTS c1 INTEGER, IF NOT EXISTS c2 INTEGER
CREATE TABLE prop_head CHANGE_TRACKING=TRUE DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS=1 (id INTEGER)
ALTER TABLE prop_head UNSET DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS, CHANGE_TRACKING
CREATE TABLE vp_src (c INTEGER, region VARCHAR)
CREATE VIEW vp_head CHANGE_TRACKING=TRUE (c) AS SELECT c FROM vp_src
CREATE VIEW vp_tail (c) CHANGE_TRACKING=TRUE AS SELECT c FROM vp_src
CREATE ROW ACCESS POLICY policy AS (r VARCHAR) RETURNS BOOLEAN -> r = 'EU'
CREATE VIEW vp_rap (region COMMENT 'per-column comment') WITH ROW ACCESS POLICY test_db.test_schema.policy ON (region) COMMENT='view comment' AS (SELECT region FROM vp_src)
CREATE SEQUENCE seq_with WITH START=1 INCREMENT=1 ORDER
CREATE SEQUENCE seq_commas WITH START=5, INCREMENT=10 ORDER
CREATE SEQUENCE seq_inline START=3 COMMENT = 'counts things' INCREMENT=2
CREATE WAREHOUSE IF NOT EXISTS my_wh WITH WAREHOUSE_SIZE = 'XSMALL' AUTO_SUSPEND = 60 INITIALLY_SUSPENDED = TRUE
CREATE DYNAMIC TABLE dyn_after TARGET_LAG='1 minute' WAREHOUSE=my_wh (id) AS SELECT id FROM dyn_src
CREATE DYNAMIC TABLE dyn_before (a) TARGET_LAG='20 minutes' WAREHOUSE=my_wh AS SELECT id FROM dyn_src
